name: What information does a general contractor need from an electrical sub-trade for effective coordination?

mainEntity.name: What information does a general contractor need from an electrical sub-trade for effective coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: For effective coordination, a general contractor requires detailed information from the electrical sub-trade including precise scope of work, installation drawings, equipment specifications, power requirements, and a detailed schedule with dependencies. We also need information on required access, staging areas, and specific coordination points with other trades (e.g., locations of panels, light fixtures relative to HVAC ducts). This comprehensive data enables City Dweller, LLC to integrate the electrical work seamlessly into the overall project plan and anticipate potential conflicts.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor needs detailed scope, drawings, equipment specs, schedule, and access requirements from the electrical sub-trade for effective coordination.
